svg.title: Tile setter — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as tile setter, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: Four separate floor tiles sit above a notched adhesive trowel with a raised hand grip. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a tapered face.
